**PotentialPatina 1.2.0**

- **ROLL**: one tap switches on a random set of sections with random settings, for a new kind of old sound each time. **MILD** keeps it subtle (no digital crunch or room), **MEDIUM** may add them, **WILD** turns most things on and up. OUTPUT is left alone. Keep rolling until you like it, then fine-tune.
- MAGNITUDE, MIX and OUTPUT moved up a little to make room for it. Two parameters were added at the end of the list (Roll, Roll Wildness); saved projects open as before.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialPatina-1.2.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpatina/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialPatina-1.2.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialPatina-1.2.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialPatina-1.2.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpatina/issues/new/choose).
